name: Phyrexia
description: Phyrexia is an artificial plane of mechanical and biomechanical life made of nested spheres, founded by Yawgmoth and later reborn as New Phyrexia on conquered Mirrodin, the home of the invading Phyrexians.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra discover a stone in the Caves of Koilos; disturbed, it splits into Mightstone and Weakstone and unleashes Phyrexia's evil on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: unleashing the evil of Phyrexia on Dominaria

citation.text: "Antiquities", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra journeys to Phyrexia and returns changed, darker and more dangerous.
timeline.quote: Whatever the interpretation, it is plain that Mishra's character changes drastically at this point, becoming darker and more dangerous.

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 1: The Story of Urza and Mishra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Phyrexia's founding, Gix is among the first compleated and becomes Yawgmoth's right-hand man in the Thran-Phyrexian War.
timeline.quote: Gix became one of the first living beings to be Compleat ed

citation.text: "Gix", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the war the Phyrexians are trapped on Phyrexia when Rebbec closes the portal.
timeline.quote: when the Thran architect Rebbec closed the portal connecting Phyrexia to Dominaria

citation.text: "Gix", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xantcha is created at the Fane of Flesh as a Phyrexian sleeper agent.
timeline.quote: The Fane of Flesh on the Fourth Sphere of Phyrexia was where Xantcha and several other hundreds of newts of her pod were created.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xantcha is sent to the First Sphere to be taught how to survive on her target plane; she begins to think for herself.
timeline.quote: she thought for herself.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xantcha meets Gix, receives her name and chooses a female identity as rebellion; he fails to break her mind.
timeline.quote: Xantcha thus had gained both her name and her gender from her first meeting with Gix.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The first newts are found out and killed by Dominaria's inhabitants, and assignments stop; Xantcha is forgotten.
timeline.quote: Xantcha, largely forgotten, waited for an assignment that never came.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Shard of Twelve Worlds closes Phyrexia off from Dominaria, and Yawgmoth harshly punishes Gix as Xantcha watches.
timeline.quote: For this oversight, Gix was harshly punished by Yawgmoth with a grand display that Xantcha personally observed.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza attacks the returned Phyrexians and follows them home, beginning his Assault on Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Urza attacked, and followed the fleeing Phyrexians to their home plane, starting Urza's Assault on Phyrexia .

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Travel with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth halts Urza and assaults his mind; Xantcha gets her life matrix, shakes Urza from his stupor and he planeswalks them away.
timeline.quote: he planeswalked them away to safety.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Travel with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leshrac is tracked down by Taysir and imprisoned in Phyrexia, later freed.
timeline.quote: He was eventually tracked down by Taysir and imprisoned in Phyrexia .

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "The Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza reveals he foresaw the betrayal and uses Szat's life energy to fuel the soul bombs that devastate Phyrexia, killing him.
timeline.quote: Fueling the bombs was the end of Szat.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Nine Titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza attacks Phyrexia but is defeated and corrupted by Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Urza launches an attack on Phyrexia , but is defeated.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Ice Age (450 AR to 2934 AR) [ 17 ] [ 53 ] [ 50 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves summons the survivors to Phyrexia, where demons kill Channa; she dons the Stone Brain and saves her friends.
timeline.quote: who kill the scout Channa

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir defeats Leshrac but cannot kill him and imprisons him deep in Phyrexia instead.
timeline.quote: he imprisoned Leshrac deep in hellish Phyrexia instead

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Homelands". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorine says Dagsson ignored Phyrexia's lessons in building a mechanical utopia.
timeline.quote: "Dagsson should have paid attention to the lessons of Phyrexia before attempting to create a mechanical utopia."

citation.text: Phyrexian Boon (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Haakon summons Phyrexian gremlins who snatch the Stone Brain and return to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: they snatched the artifact and returned to their home plane

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves planeswalks to Phyrexia with friends, dons the Stone Brain, and uses spells from its voices to destroy demons and return home.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves was successful in planeswalking to Phyrexia, bringing some of her friends with her.

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek sells secrets of Phyrexia at a steep price.
timeline.quote: "The secrets of Phyrexia are expensive. You will pay in brass and bone, steel and sinew."

citation.text: Phyrexian Vault (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gix rises to the rank of praetor in the Phyrexian regime.
timeline.quote: Gix rose through the Phyrexian regime to the exalted rank of praetor.

citation.text: Gix (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Xantcha is sentenced to death by Phyrexia but rescued by Urza.
timeline.quote: she was rescued by Urza and joined his crusade.

citation.text: Xantcha (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth sits poised to invade Dominaria four thousand years after Urza and Mishra reopened the portal to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: the evil lord Yawgmoth sits poised to invade his one-time home

citation.text: "Weatherlight", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Five years after the Sylex Blast Urza returns to Dominaria, sees a vision on Koilos, learns the stolen powerstone was a keystone against Phyrexia, and swears vengeance.
timeline.quote: Urza swears vengeance on Phyrexia and vows to destroy it.

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xantcha is created in the Fourth Sphere as a sleeper agent; Gix opens her mind; she sabotages missions and is saved from execution by Urza.
timeline.quote: Xantcha is created as a newt in the Fourth of Nine Spheres to be a sleeper agent sent to Dominaria.

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza enters Phyrexia with a dragon engine and destroys swaths of it; Xantcha recovers her heart and tells him to planeswalk away.
timeline.quote: Xantcha follows him and recovers her heart from the Fourth Sphere

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vuel is transported to Rath through Starke's portal, gives himself to Phyrexia, and becomes Volrath, evincar of Rath.
timeline.quote: he gave himself to Phyrexia , becoming Volrath, the new evincar of Rath, a shapeshifter and master of flowstone manipulation.

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax is taken to Phyrexia, where Kirril compleats him into a Phyrexian and he is groomed as evincar of Rath.
timeline.quote: he was to become the new evincar of Rath, needing only to prove himself to his masters before he could take the throne.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Dark rebirth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra and Ashnod find a portal to Phyrexia in Koilos and are attacked by the demon Gix, then close the portal.
timeline.quote: Mishra and Ashnod escape and close the portal.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza attacks Phyrexia and Phyrexia slowly retaliates.
timeline.quote: Urza dared to attack Phyrexia. Slowly, it retaliated.

citation.text: Sicken (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza drains Tevesh Szat to power the soul bombs and later destroys Taysir; the Titans mutiny.
timeline.quote: Urza used the same failsafe and destroyed Taysir.

citation.text: "Bo Levar", section "Nine Titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Levar leads the last Titans to plant the bombs and destroy Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Levar led the last titans to plant the bombs and destroy the plane .

citation.text: "Bo Levar", section "Nine Titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rebbec seals the portal to Phyrexia, locking Yawgmoth out for millennia as Halcyon falls.
timeline.quote: Rebbec managed to seal the portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia, locking Yawgmoth out for millennia.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Thran Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth's wrath falls on Gix after the rift cuts Phyrexia off, and Gix is cast into the Punishment Sphere.
timeline.quote: cast down into Phyrexia's Punishment Sphere to be tortured indefinitely

citation.text: "Gix", section "Sleeper agents". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth is brought to Phyrexia by the planeswalker Dyfed, long before the Invasion.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia was not so different from Mirrodin until Yawgmoth arrived thousands of years ago, brought there by the planeswalker Dyfed.

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Yawgmoth's refuge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth and the Thran exiles, saved through Phyresis, flee to Phyrexia after being forced out of the Thran Empire; the war destroys the Thran.
timeline.quote: The ensuing war destroyed the nation of the Thran.

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Yawgmoth's refuge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Xantcha assault Phyrexia, blasting a hole to the Fourth Sphere before being driven off by Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Urza blasted a giant hole in the plane down to the Fourth Sphere

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "The return of Gix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza attacks Phyrexia, blasts a hole down to the 4th Sphere, but Yawgmoth invades his mind and drives him further insane.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth himself invaded his mind and made him go even more insane

citation.text: "Urza", section "Exploring the Origins of Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The set's story follows Urza as he travels the planes seeking weapons to destroy the dark forces that stalk him.
timeline.quote: he travels the planes seeking weapons to destroy the dark forces that stalk him

citation.text: "Urza's Saga", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Kyren, once guardians of Thran council members, grow corrupt and become allies of Phyrexia and Rath.
timeline.quote: They are the descendants of a group of Goblins from Dominaria during the time of the Thran who were left in Mercadia

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Kyren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avila's former lover, turned into a Phyrexian agent, poisons her and delivers her body to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: He poisoned Avila despite his love for her

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Phyrexia, Abcal-dro reconstructs Avila's body as a cyborg, names her Belbe and implants the Eye of Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: A black sphere was then implanted in her body

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexia chose Crovax to take Volrath's place and bestowed new powers on him.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia has chosen Crovax to take Volrath's place

citation.text: "Nemesis", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rath's rebels united in Eladamri's name to break free of Phyrexia's tyranny.
timeline.quote: Rath's rebels have united in the name of Eladamri , Lord of Leaves, to break free of Phyrexia's tyranny once and for all.

citation.text: "Nemesis", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Weatherlight escapes Rath, Ertai is captured aboard the Predator and Crovax is taken to Phyrexia, where Kirril shapes him into Volrath's successor.
timeline.quote: Ertai is captured and held aboard the Predator

citation.text: "Nemesis (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The hordes of Phyrexia begin pouring into Dominaria, and the world looks to Urza for defense; Urza gathers heroes, renegades, common folk and artifacts to fight.
timeline.quote: Urza gathers heroes, renegades, common folk, and powerful artifacts to fight the invasion.

citation.text: "Invasion", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza leads the Nine Titans in a counter-attack on Phyrexia; Tevesh Szat betrays and kills Daria, and Urza kills him, sealing him in a soul bomb.
timeline.quote: Urza activated the rubrik and killed Szat, sealing him in a Soul bomb

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Counter attack and betrayal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza is convinced to kill Taysir, then is taken to see Mishra in the Seventh Sphere and brought to worship Yawgmoth in the Ninth.
timeline.quote: Next, he went to the Ninth Sphere to worship Yawgmoth himself, along with Gerrard.

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Counter attack and betrayal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth strips Urza of his planeswalker powers and forces him to fight Gerrard; Gerrard beheads Urza.
timeline.quote: Gerrard managed to land a strike that beheaded Urza

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Urza vs. Gerrard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karona the False God claims to have met Teferi and found Phyrexia, a claim later proven false.
timeline.quote: it is thought that Karona had been delusional

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth, a Thran eugenicist, takes over an idyllic world with Dyfed's help and brings his followers there, creating the first Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: he brought his followers to this new world, the first Phyrexia

citation.text: "Phyrexian", section "Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The pneumagogs pursue Urza to join the Phyrexian cause.
timeline.quote: they pursued Urza to join the Phyrexian cause

citation.text: "Phyrexian", section "Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yavimaya, led by Multani with Gaea's support, destroys or transforms every invading Phyrexian.
timeline.quote: The result was a total defeat for Phyrexia

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "First stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Llanowar is defended by Molimo, Multani and the Weatherlight crew, with great losses including King Fhedusil and Takara en-Dal.
timeline.quote: they succeeded in repelling the Phyrexians with immense effort

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "First stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexia captures Urborg as a staging ground for the Rathi Overlay.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia succeeded in capturing Urborg as a staging ground for the Rathi Overlay

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "First stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin obliterates Tolaria with himself and the invaders, after sealing his daughter's corpse in a sarcophagus.
timeline.quote: cast obliterating , erasing himself, the island, its invaders, and all remaining inhabitants and structures

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "First stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Rathi Overlay brings Rath's Phyrexian legions onto Dominaria, and Crovax kills Tsabo Tavoc for failing at Koilos.
timeline.quote: Crovax killed Tsabo Tavoc as punishment for her failure at Koilos

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Second stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Keldon Twilight sweeps the Phyrexian armies away in meltwater, an absolute loss for Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: this battle was an absolute loss for the Phyrexians

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Second stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Nine Titans counterattack Phyrexia directly; several are killed and Urza defects to Yawgmoth.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth makes Gerrard and Urza duel; Gerrard decapitates Urza and discovers the Hanna he fought for was Yawgmoth in disguise.
timeline.quote: the duel ended with Gerrard decapitating Urza

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Final stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: the first seven spheres of Phyrexia were wrecked

timeline.quote: The lower levels of the Stronghold were buried in molten rock

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Final stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir is recruited among the Nine Titans for the attack on Phyrexia, with Daria taking Teferi's place and Urza insisting on Szat.
timeline.quote: Taysir was one of the Nine Titans recruited by Urza to participate in the attack on Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat kills Kristina and later Daria during the assault.
timeline.quote: Szat killed Kristina by "accident" early in the assault, then hunted down and deliberately killed Daria later on.

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When Urza switches allegiance to Phyrexia, Taysir attacks him and Urza kills him by activating the kill rubric in his Titan Engine.
timeline.quote: Urza activated the kill rubric in Taysir's Titan Engine , killing him.

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lord Windgrace performs the ritual of Dalfir on Taysir's body.
timeline.quote: performed the ritual of Dalfir on him

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
